name: laravel bindings
sql: select * from `users` where `id` = ? limit 1
fingerprint: select * from users where id = ? limit ?

name: slow log literals
sql: select * from `users` where `id` = 5 limit 1;
fingerprint: select * from users where id = ? limit ?

name: performance_schema digest
sql: SELECT * FROM `users` WHERE `id` = ? LIMIT ?
fingerprint: select * from users where id = ? limit ?

name: strings with escapes
sql: SELECT id FROM logs WHERE msg = 'it\'s' AND note = 'a''b'
fingerprint: select id from logs where msg = ? and note = ?

name: in list
sql: select * from orders where user_id in (1, 2, 3, 4) and status = 'paid'
fingerprint: select * from orders where user_id in (...) and status = ?

name: in list of bindings
sql: select * from orders where user_id in (?, ?, ?)
fingerprint: select * from orders where user_id in (...)

name: multi row insert
sql: INSERT INTO t (a, b) VALUES (1, 'x'), (2, 'y'), (3, 'z')
fingerprint: insert into t (a, b) values (...)

name: postgres params
sql: SELECT * FROM "users" WHERE email = $1 AND age > $2
fingerprint: select * from users where email = ? and age > ?

name: whitespace and operators
sql:
select   *
 from t where a>=1   and b<>'x'  and c  <  2.5
fingerprint: select * from t where a >= ? and b <> ? and c < ?

name: comments
sql: /* request 42 */ select count(*) as aggregate from `products`
fingerprint: select count(*) as aggregate from products

name: identifiers with digits
sql: select t1.id from table2 t1 where t1.x = 10
fingerprint: select t1.id from table2 t1 where t1.x = ?

name: json extract
sql: select * from `docs` where json_unquote(json_extract(`params`, '$."foglio"')) = '12'
fingerprint: select * from docs where json_unquote(json_extract(params, ?)) = ?

name: hex and negatives
sql: update t set flags = 0xFF, delta = -3 where id = 7
fingerprint: update t set flags = ?, delta = -? where id = ?

name: parenthesis spacing
sql: select * from t where ( a = 1 ) and b in ( 'x' )
fingerprint: select * from t where (a = ?) and b in (...)

name: python pyformat params (psycopg2, PyMySQL)
sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id = %(id)s AND city = %s
fingerprint: select name from customers where id = ? and city = ?

name: named params (PDO, SQLAlchemy text) but not postgres casts
sql: SELECT SUM(total) FROM orders WHERE customer_id::text = :customer AND status=:status
fingerprint: select sum(total) from orders where customer_id::text = ? and status = ?

name: function with one binding is not an in list
sql: select id from customers where lower(city) = lower(%(c)s)
fingerprint: select id from customers where lower(city) = lower(?)

name: performance_schema digest spacing matches the application text
sql: SELECT COUNT ( * ) AS `n` FROM `orders` WHERE LOWER ( `city` ) = ? OR `total` > ?
fingerprint: select count(*) as n from orders where lower(city) = ? or total > ?

name: application text of the same query
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE lower(city) = ? OR total > ?
fingerprint: select count(*) as n from orders where lower(city) = ? or total > ?

name: keywords keep their space before a parenthesis
sql: SELECT * FROM t WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM u) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1) AND a IN ( ? , ? )
fingerprint: select * from t where id not in (select id from u) and exists (select ?) and a in (...)
